review_candidates.title: Desktop Engineer L1
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Responsibilities Perform incident resolution and service request fulfillment activities in accordance with defined procedures and SLAs. Assist remote teams with basic troubleshooting, health checks, connectivity verification, device status validation, equipment reboot, and physical inspection activities. (laptop, desktops ) Maintain asset, inventory, procurement and device information in approved IT service management and asset management tools. Adhere to company security, safety, compliance
eligibility_evidence: Support deployment, replacement, refresh, relocation, collection, and decommissioning activities for IT equipment.
Participate in major incidents and provide onsite support when physical intervention is required.
Support local technology projects and business activities requiring onsite IT presence.
Act as the local onsite contact for Smart Hands activities and coordinate effectively with remote support teams.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Adhere to company security, safety, compliance, confidentiality, ITAR, and Export Control requirements applicable to the supported site. Requirements Experience in Smart Hands Support, Field Services, Desktop Support, Infrastructure Support, or a related IT support role. Proficiency in German (preferably at C1 level or higher)
